scope: Current project source reading for S09 acceptance mapping, no project execution or implementation claim
findings: useEditorChrome canCtrlZ starts false and becomes true from both onUpdate and onTransaction; this flag is not proof of a nonempty undo stack
historyUndo/historyRedo beforeinput capture has a separate canCtrlZ check; command and keyboard gates require separate project acceptance
collaboration undo/redo checks Yjs undoManager stacks; Mod-z, Mod-y and Shift-Mod-z map to these commands
when hasCollab, StarterKit undoRedo is disabled and Collaboration binds collabField with protectedNodes
effective editability combines mode permission, AI locks and generation lock, then setEditable follows it
history restoration uses stateless restoreSnapshot with versionId/requestId/historyType and separate collaboration readiness checks
